name: Ravine Hotel
why_special: Senior Panchgani 4-star with 50 rooms across landscaped grounds on the ridge — heated pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, mountain views toward Table Land. The local longest-running mid-tier in Panchgani; consistent reviews on Tripadvisor.

name: Citrus Chambers Mahabaleshwar (Panchgani road)
why_special: Citrus Hotels' 50-room resort midway between Panchgani and Mahabaleshwar — outdoor pool, mountain ridge views toward Krishna Valley. The pick when you want both hill stations in one base; closer to Panchgani's Table Land.

name: SaffronStays Verandah by the Valley
why_special: 5-bedroom SaffronStays villa on the valley edge of Khingar village — private pool, full kitchen, the Panchgani vacation-rental pick for groups of 8–12 over a resort. Books out months ahead for long weekends.
